doc: spec 4.2 routing table, as data; failure_router.py reads it. Rows are tried in order: a row with `when` fires only when the rows its filter keeps reach its threshold in distinct legs, else the next row is tried; the first matching row without `when` decides the class. `summary` and `row` are the only template text a Jira body or summary may carry.

routes.row: signal-only in v1 (Q11): written, shown and counted, never routed
signal-only in v1 (Q11): written, shown and counted, never routed
folded into the ticket of the hook the retried call hit, no second ticket

routes.summary: investigate: classifier {sub} denials recurred in {legs} legs
routes.row: denied/classifier:<cat> recurred: investigate, a denial may be correct; memory candidate to the inbox

routes.summary: investigate: permission prompts recurred in {legs} legs
routes.row: denied/permission-prompt recurred: check the leg profile or its allow list

routes.summary: legs retype past {sub}: its refusal text or a playbook entry does not land
routes.row: denied/<hook> with identical retry recurred: fix the refusal text or add a stuck-playbook entry

routes.summary: {sub} is hit by most legs: does the brief template or preface teach the wrong shape
routes.row: denied/<hook> recovered with no retry in 5 or more legs: the guard works, the teaching does not

routes.summary: {sub} left red at wrap in {legs} legs: flaky or main-red candidate
routes.row: suite/<test-file> left red at wrap: apply the CI-red triage policy
a red suite inside a leg is RED-first working
error/<tool> in 3 or more legs: a tool-use shape keeps failing
the station owns it: the bank and quota monitors
